b:
When even the tree that sprouted from a seed
looks up toward the sky,
O nectar of the sea that spreads over the shore,
will your love last?

At the hour when eyes close,
wanting the comfort
lips give,
you too give kisses in your desire

Fainting
in the waves
of your kisses,
the Earth herself
waits
for a moment's rest

The force of love
and the heat of waiting
together:
as you come running with longing,
a few tiny feet
think to stop you

And the Earth,
in gratitude,
buries them
in her heart

There the love
of the rolling sea
disappears

and there blossoms
a
new heaven
